thig7.2:1.1: satiṃ upaṭṭhapetvāna bhikkhunī bhāvitindriyā | paṭivijjhiṃ padaṃ santaṃ saṅkhārūpasamaṃ sukhaṃ. || ||
thig7.2:2.1: kin nu uddissa muṇḍā si samaṇī viya dissasi | na ca rocesi pāsaṇḍe kim idaṃ carasi momuhā. || ||
thig7.2:3.1: ito bahiddhā pāsaṇḍā diṭṭhiyo upanissitā | na te dhammaṃ vijānanti na te dhammassa kovidā. || ||
thig7.2:4.1: atthi Sakyakule jāto buddho appaṭipuggalo | so me dhammam adesesi diṭṭhīnaṃ samatikkamaṃ. || ||
thig7.2:5.1: dukkhaṃ dukkhasamuppādaṃ dukkhassa ca atikkamaṃ | ariyaṭṭhaṅgikaṃ maggaṃ dukkhūpasamagāminaṃ. || ||
thig7.2:6.1: tassāhaṃ vacanaṃ sutvā vihariṃ sāsane ratā | tisso vijjā anuppattā kataṃ buddhassa sāsanaṃ. || ||
thig7.2:7.1: sabbattha vihatā nandi tamokkhandho padālito | evaṃ jānāhi pāpima nihato tvam asi antaka. || ||
